mapper.select: SELECT city_region.code as cityCode, city_region.name as cityName, COUNT(tl.id) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successTasks, CASE WHEN COUNT(tl.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(tl.id), 2) END as completionRate FROM task_log tl INNER JOIN clean_area ca ON tl.area_id = ca.id INNER JOIN region city_region ON SUBSTRING(ca.region_code, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(city_region.code, 1, 4) AND city_region.level = 2 WHERE DATE(tl.start_time) BETWEEN DATE(#{startDate}) AND DATE(#{endDate}) GROUP BY city_region.code, city_region.name ORDER BY totalTasks DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (5 - n.num) MONTH), '%Y-%m') as yearMonth, COUNT(tl.id) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failTasks, CASE WHEN COUNT(tl.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(tl.id), 2) END as failRate FROM ( SELECT 0 as num UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ) n LEFT JOIN task_log tl ON DATE_FORMAT(tl.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (5 - n.num) MONTH), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth

SELECT city_region.code as cityCode, city_region.name as cityName, COUNT(tl.id) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successTasks FROM task_log tl INNER JOIN clean_area ca ON tl.area_id = ca.id INNER JOIN region city_region ON SUBSTRING(ca.region_code, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(city_region.code, 1, 4) AND city_region.level = 2 WHERE DATE_FORMAT(tl.start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY city_region.code, city_region.name ORDER BY successTasks DESC, totalTasks DESC LIMIT 10
